note: ADR 1122 (review of ADR 1107 round 2, the SC1003 false positives main also has): a `then` slot in any spelling (default, renamed default, nested empty value, escaped, renamed, quoted, a computed const behind a comment) does not warn, and a pattern holding only a comment reads nothing; SC1003 is uncertifiable or absent there. Another key (`{ then, v }`, a comment beside `v`, a computed literal `["v"]`) warns and stays a violation.
